en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Romanian publication of the Romania–Czech Republic treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on dividends where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official Romanian treaty text; the official text controls.

Article 11 — Interest. The official Romanian publication of the Romania–Czech Republic treaty provides a general 7 per cent source-State ceiling where the recipient is the beneficial owner. Qualifying non-commercial interest connected with a government, local authority, territorial-administrative unit, government agency, bank or body, or a claim guaranteed, secured or directly or indirectly financed by a wholly government-owned financial institution, is exempt in the source State when the treaty conditions are met. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official Romanian treaty text; the official text controls.

Article 12 — Royalties. The official Romanian publication of the Romania–Czech Republic treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on royalties where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official Romanian treaty text; the official text controls.
